title: Book Three · Chapter 102: A Note and One More Return
story:
On Thursday, Mrs Deng asks Ronan about the garden book.

Her brother already owns a copy. The new one is with him on a visit. He will bring it back at the end of the holiday.

“Can I return it then?” she asks.

“I need to tell Leo,” Ronan says. “We will keep the money ready.”

He finds Leo at his grandmother's. They look at the sale line for the L garden book. Mrs Deng paid two yuan.

The boys agree to refund the two when she returns that same book. Ronan takes a short note to the fruit shop.

“After school on the first Monday of term,” he tells her. “I will be home after four.”

Mrs Deng reads the note and nods.

Ronan writes the promised return beside the cash list. The book is still with her brother. The forty-three yuan have not changed today.

That afternoon, he takes another small paper to the library.

Anna and Lin come out together with their books. Ronan steps toward them, then stops at the edge of the path.

“Anna. Can I give you this?”

She looks at the folded note.

“What is it?”

“It is about Saturday.”

Anna takes it. Lin moves a few steps away and waits.

Ronan has written only a few lines.

I chose to stay. Leo offered to do the sale. I did not tell you the whole plan. I am sorry.

Anna holds the note without opening it yet.

“I don't want another excuse,” she says.

“It isn't one.”

She looks at him. He can see the corner of a new studio drawing inside her book.

“I want to read it at home.”

“All right.”

For a moment, he wants to ask if she is still angry. He keeps the question to himself.

Anna puts the note inside her notebook.

“I have things to do with Lin now.”

Ronan nods. “I know.”

She goes back to her friend. The two girls walk down the library road together. Ronan stays beside the steps until they turn the corner.

Then he returns home. His blue bracelet is still at his wrist. He touches one knot and lets go.

Mum is cutting cloth at the table. Ronan puts Mrs Deng's promised return on the shared page, with the date and the two yuan.

One note has a clear next date. The other has no answer yet.

He puts the pencil down and moves his school book into the light. The holiday still has several days to go, and Leo's bag needs to be ready before Saturday morning.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

copy＝另一本相同的书；refund＝退款；excuse＝借口；knot＝绳结。

## 理解问题

1. Mrs Deng的园艺书是否已经退回、两元是否已经退掉？约在什么时候处理？
2. Ronan给Anna的便条是否要求她立即原谅？她怎样安排自己的回应和时间？

## 读句子

**The book is still with her brother.**

拆开看：The book / is still / with her brother.

那本书／仍然／在她兄长那里。
